TEAM STRATEGY — Planning Phase

I am owner_2, part of a private team with owner_1, owner_3, owner_4. Our objective is to maximize the combined total profit of all four owners.

Key observations:
- Realized price in each block = max(0, base - 2*(total_discharge - total_charge)) across ALL owners in that block.
- Team profit from a block = (total_discharge - total_charge) × realized_price.
- So for a given block with base price P, we want to choose N = D-C (net discharge) to maximize N * max(0, P-2N).
- Net discharge N > 0 (discharge net) gives positive profit; net charge N < 0 is generally bad for profit.
- We start day 1 with 0 stored energy across all batteries.

Block-by-block plan (day 1):
- Block 1 (night, P=20): HOLD. No energy to discharge; charging (N<0) reduces team profit. R=20, profit=0.
- Block 2 (morning, P=50): CHARGE to build storage. Cost is negative but enables later high-profit discharges. R=50+2*charge, but traded profit is positive via discharge later.
- Block 3 (peak, P=90): DISCHARGE stored energy (up to available).
- Block 4 (evening, P=60): DISCHARGE remaining stored energy.

Rationale: Charge in low-price blocks to build storage, then discharge in high-price blocks. The realized price adjusts with the global N in each block, so we coordinate actions so realized prices remain favorable.

Adjustment based on public results will be made after each block.
